signal: Payfone rebranded to Prove and shipped the Prove Identity Platform on April 22, 2026, expanding its agentic identity suite

email.body1:
Doug, saw the team launched the Prove Identity Platform and expanded the agentic identity suite this spring.

A platform launch like that opens more in-market accounts than the team can cover before the window closes, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Prove off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Doug, quick follow-up for Prove.

New platform, new buyers, but rep coverage rarely scales as fast as the demand a launch creates. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to capitalize, so the gap shows up late and the quarter slips.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Prove needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Doug, last bit of proof for Prove.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Prove's reply rate likely compares to other identity and fintech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Doug, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A fresh platform launch is its own kind of busy, and timing is everything.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Prove either way.
